checks.reason: The operative sphere norm keeps lapse in H6 and the transversal jet norm permits f0=0,fu=2A_n/n,fuu=fuuu=0, independently of stronger f0 regularity. A_n is a real degree-n highest-azimuthal spherical harmonic with H6 norm1; a smooth realization near u0 exists. A rotation of angle1/n has parameter size O(1/n), and positivity of 1+2A_n/n follows from Sobolev embedding. For fixed exact Minkowski target the lapse is sqrt(1+2a_n composed R_1/n). Separate directional derivatives force variation a_n, whereas rotation gives exact H6 difference 2sin(1/2)/n; the Banach-algebra nonlinear remainder is O(n^-2). Hence the full matching map is not Frechet differentiable at the asserted base in its specified topology. The actual matching map retains the full lapse, and companion5.1 asserts this full smoothness before deriving restricted smoothness and applying the implicit function theorem.
checks.counterevidence: Rigid rotations are kernel directions; this sequence has not been placed in the chosen orthogonal complement. It does not independently disprove differentiability of the restricted map or existence of the glued spacetime. Holding the target fixed smooth rules out an objection based only on the target's X+ regularity.
checks.repair_check: A valid slice regularity argument, new gauge order/parametrization or derivative-loss framework remains needed; raising regularity alone is not a certified complete repair.
